state.product: Zenno — universal booking layer making local appointment businesses bookable by AI assistants. Hamburg first. Tiny team, founder is non-technical and wants to launch fast.
state.problem: Today an assistant connected to Zenno's MCP server can search every business, but can only hold and book at a business whose own key it holds. One connection cannot book everywhere.

research.mcp_spec_2025_06_18: MCP authorization is optional. When used, the MCP server is an OAuth 2.1 resource server; the MCP client acts on behalf of a resource owner (the end user) who signs in and consents. Tokens must be issued for this specific server (audience-bound), short-lived, never in URLs. Clients should use dynamic client registration so any assistant can connect without manual setup.
research.chatgpt_apps_sdk: ChatGPT acts as the OAuth public client on behalf of the user. Authentication is only required for user-specific writes; public tools (catalog search) can run without auth. Servers may be OAuth, No Auth, or Mixed. Example: a hotel app keeps search_hotels public and requires sign-in to book.
research.reserve_with_google: Google calls one partner booking server with a single HTTP basic credential that covers all of that partner's merchants, rotated every six months. This works because Google is one vetted partner under a contract, not an open marketplace of anonymous clients.
research.safety_mode: The coding assistant's safety mode refused to build a single platform key able to book at every business. OAuth per customer does not create such a credential: each token only lets that signed-in customer book or cancel their own appointments.

state.existing_assets: Supabase Auth is already used in the app for merchants and has customer accounts support; Supabase Auth can act as an OAuth 2.1 authorization server for MCP clients.

effort_estimates.customer_oauth_mixed_mode: About 1-2 days: OAuth metadata endpoints, customer sign-in/consent page, token check in agent-mcp; public tools stay open. No founder approval needed.
effort_estimates.platform_keys_with_guardrails: About half a day of code, but blocked until the founder explicitly approves a broad credential; each AI platform must still be onboarded and given a key manually.
effort_estimates.keep_business_keys: No work, but no assistant can book across businesses.

agent_auth_model.instructions: Which authentication model should Zenno build next so real AI assistants can book at every AI-enabled business, given `state.research`, `state.existing_assets` and `state.effort_estimates`?

criteria.customer_oauth_mixed_mode: Standard MCP/ChatGPT approach: search and business details stay public; holding, booking, cancelling and rescheduling require the customer to sign in once with Zenno through OAuth, and each token only acts for that customer.
criteria.platform_keys_with_guardrails: One key per AI platform that can book at every AI-enabled business, with rate limits, audit log and revocation, after founder approval.
criteria.keep_business_keys: Keep one key per business for launch.

keep_business_keys_as_advanced.instructions: After the chosen model ships, should per-business keys remain available under the merchant's Advanced section for custom integrations?

criteria.keep: Keep them hidden under Advanced for developers building a custom assistant for one business.
